correctness.rationale: Steiner Gram-determinant sum, telescoping Gram-Schmidt projection constants, exact second canonical Hoeffding kernel and orthogonality imply finite means/covariances and rank-one joint normalization. Higher-order canonical variance is O(n^(2k-3)); the Bernstein representation of sqrt(1-t^2) makes the opposite centered spherical kernel positive definite with strictly positive even Gegenbauer eigenvalues. Mercer trace, fixed-band CLT and Hilbert-Schmidt tail give the chi-square law and its sharp bounds. The package verifier independently checks finite determinant geometry, gamma constants and third-order remainder; the infinite proof is analytic.

value.rationale: All Steiner intrinsic volumes on one random body form a canonical geometric vector. Their exact finite sample cross-covariances and common one-sided non-Gaussian limit are a structural dependence law unavailable from separate means or a single 3D volume fluctuation. The result exposes a sharp degeneracy of generic Gaussian fluctuation theory, applies to every index in each fixed dimension, and yields a simple universal leading inference relation.
